boundary: Evidence custody/provenance support only; not live election evidence, not live-pilot authorization, not chain-of-custody certification, not public-records authorization, not admissibility opinion, not outcome proof, not proof of intent or fraud, and not legal advice.
non_claims: This pack does not authorize a live pilot or public release of local evidence.
This pack does not certify chain of custody or court admissibility.
This pack does not prove election outcome correctness, intent, fraud, or misconduct.
This pack does not replace local counsel, public-records, retention, or election-office procedure.

rows.custody_floor: Record capture request, jurisdiction/election scope, authorized surfaces, excluded data, capture window, and approving role before collection.
rows.custody_risk: An operator captures material outside the approved pilot scope or later cannot show who requested the capture.
rows.next_action: Record who authorized collection, what surfaces are in scope, and what data is excluded before capture.
rows.non_claims: not live authorization; not outcome certification; not proof of intent or fraud; not legal advice
rows.public_boundary: Capture scope records what was authorized for collection; it is not a finding about outcome correctness or intent.
rows.required_records: capture request id; scope statement; approving role; capture window; prohibited-data list
rows.reviewer_role: custody lead and election office sponsor
rows.synthetic_status: synthetic custody floor only; no local capture authority recorded

rows.custody_floor: Record collector identity or role token, affiliation/COI note, training status, equipment owner, and whether the collector is acting as office staff, observer, contractor, or verifier.
rows.custody_risk: Evidence cannot be attributed to a named role or role changes are hidden.
rows.next_action: Bind each collector to a role, affiliation/COI note, training status, and equipment-owner record.
rows.non_claims: not proof of independence; not certification; not legal advice
rows.public_boundary: Collector attribution supports accountability; it does not make a collector independent unless independence criteria are separately met.
rows.required_records: collector role token; affiliation note; COI note; training check; equipment owner

rows.custody_floor: Record tool name/version, archive version, clock source, vantage point, network path class, and any capture limitations while minimizing private device and network identifiers.
rows.custody_risk: A snapshot is unverifiable because capture method, tool version, time source, or vantage point is missing.
rows.next_action: Record tool/archive version, time source, vantage point, and capture limitations while minimizing private identifiers.
rows.non_claims: not audience parity proof; not live evidence; not legal advice
rows.public_boundary: Capture environment describes how evidence was collected; it is not a claim that every audience saw the same artifact.
rows.required_records: tool version; archive version; time source; vantage class; limitation note

rows.custody_floor: Preserve payload digest, manifest digest, packet path, generated report digest, and any deterministic command used to rebuild or verify the packet.
rows.custody_risk: A packet verifies today but lacks a lineage record tying payload bytes, manifest bytes, and generated reports.
rows.next_action: Preserve payload, manifest, report, and command lineage for every packet or derivative.
rows.non_claims: not truth certification; not admissibility opinion; not legal advice
rows.public_boundary: Digest lineage proves byte continuity within the recorded scope; it does not prove the contents are legally sufficient or true in every respect.
rows.required_records: payload digest; manifest digest; report digest; verification command; rebuild command if applicable

rows.custody_floor: For every handoff, record from-custodian, to-custodian, timestamp, artifact digest before transfer, artifact digest after transfer, storage medium, and exception if digest cannot be recomputed.
rows.custody_risk: Evidence changes hands without a pre/post digest, timestamp, or receiving custodian.
rows.next_action: Record from/to custodian, timestamp, storage medium, and pre/post transfer digests for every handoff.
rows.non_claims: not tamper-proof guarantee; not certification; not legal advice
rows.public_boundary: A custody transfer record preserves handling history; it does not certify that no prior capture or human error occurred.
rows.required_records: from custodian; to custodian; timestamp; pre-transfer digest; post-transfer digest; storage medium
rows.synthetic_status: no local handoff records in archive

rows.custody_floor: Record who accessed each evidence family, role, purpose, access window, whether private fields were visible, and whether dissent or correction was filed.
rows.custody_risk: Reviewers, witnesses, or maintainers access evidence without bounded purpose, role, or time window.
rows.next_action: Record who accessed evidence, why, when, and whether private fields were visible.
rows.non_claims: not public-records ruling; not legal advice; not live evidence
rows.public_boundary: Access logs support accountability and redaction review; they should not expose private voter, staff, witness, or security details.
rows.required_records: access role; purpose; start/end time; private-field visibility; dissent pointer
rows.reviewer_role: privacy reviewer and human review lead

rows.custody_floor: Classify sealed/private fields, preserve private digest references, separate public derivatives, record reviewer approval, and document why any field stays withheld.
rows.custody_risk: Private, privileged, safety-sensitive, or security-sensitive evidence is published because it is digest-verifiable.
rows.next_action: Separate sealed/private fields from public derivatives and document withholding reasons.
rows.non_claims: not public-release authorization; not public-records ruling; not legal advice
rows.public_boundary: A public derivative can prove that bytes were preserved without revealing every private field; withholding is not proof of wrongdoing.
rows.required_records: sensitivity class; private digest pointer; public derivative pointer; reviewer approval; withholding reason
rows.reviewer_role: privacy reviewer counsel liaison and safety lead

rows.custody_floor: Record source evidence digest, redaction rule, accessibility/language review status, public artifact digest, publication channel, and correction/supersession pointer.
rows.custody_risk: A public summary, quickstart, screenshot, or bulletin cannot be traced back to the private evidence it summarizes.
rows.next_action: Link public summaries, quickstarts, screenshots, and bulletins to source evidence, redaction rule, and correction pointer.
rows.non_claims: not current voter instruction; not accessibility certification; not legal advice
rows.public_boundary: Public derivative lineage helps readers see what a public artifact is based on; it does not make the artifact current voter instruction.
rows.required_records: source digest; redaction rule; accessibility review status; public artifact digest; publication channel; correction pointer
rows.reviewer_role: public release owner accessibility reviewer and communications owner

rows.custody_floor: Freeze incident evidence with timestamp, capture method, evidence family, initial reviewer, non-claim boundary, and safe public sentence before later interpretation.
rows.custody_risk: A forged screenshot, key-compromise event, outage, or safety report is changed, deleted, or over-summarized before preservation.
rows.next_action: Freeze incident evidence before interpretation and attach a safe public sentence plus non-claims.
rows.non_claims: not proof of fraud; not proof of intent; not outcome certification; not legal advice
rows.public_boundary: Incident freezing preserves what was observed before interpretation; it does not prove motive, impact, or fraud.
rows.required_records: incident id; freeze timestamp; capture method; initial reviewer; non-claim boundary; safe public sentence
rows.reviewer_role: incident communications owner and human review lead

rows.custody_floor: Record release ZIP digest, verifier identity or role, offline machine description, transcript digest, extracted-tree manifest result, and storage location.
rows.custody_risk: Offline verification succeeds but no transcript or custodian proves who ran it, with what ZIP, and what output was preserved.
rows.next_action: Preserve offline drill transcript digest, ZIP digest, verifier role, machine description, and manifest result.
rows.non_claims: not proof of independence; not certification; not legal advice
rows.public_boundary: An offline transcript proves a verifier path ran for a named ZIP; it does not prove institutional independence unless reviewer identity and scope are recorded.
rows.required_records: ZIP digest; verifier role; offline machine description; transcript digest; manifest result; storage location
rows.synthetic_status: offline drill plan only; no live transcript

rows.custody_floor: Record source id, review date, reviewer role, pin hash when durable bytes are used, demotion/replacement reason, and downstream artifacts affected.
rows.custody_risk: Source freshness, pinning, or demotion decisions cannot be attributed to a reviewer or byte snapshot.
rows.next_action: Record source-review reviewer, date, pin/demotion reason, and affected artifacts.
rows.non_claims: not current authority; not legal advice; not voter instruction
rows.public_boundary: Source-review custody documents maintainer handling; it is not proof that any source is current public authority.
rows.required_records: source id; review date; reviewer role; pin hash or demotion reason; affected artifacts

rows.custody_floor: Record chain gaps, exception reason, responsible owner, reviewer dissent, public boundary sentence, and expiration/review date before relying on the evidence.
rows.custody_risk: Custody gaps, unresolved conflicts, reviewer dissent, or missing transfer fields are hidden to preserve a false sense of closure.
rows.next_action: Make chain gaps, exceptions, reviewer dissent, owners, and expiry dates visible before relying on evidence.
rows.non_claims: not proof of wrongdoing; not legal advice; not certification
rows.public_boundary: A chain-gap record makes uncertainty visible; it does not excuse overclaiming or prove misconduct.
rows.required_records: gap id; exception reason; owner; dissent pointer; boundary sentence; expiration date
rows.reviewer_role: human review lead and records custodian

rows.custody_floor: Record retention rule, disposition action, artifact digest, owner, date, private/public derivative status, and any legal hold or exception.
rows.custody_risk: Evidence is retained, sealed, returned, or destroyed without a digest, date, rule pointer, or accountable owner.
rows.next_action: Record disposition action, retention rule, digest, owner, legal hold, and date.
rows.non_claims: not admissibility opinion; not public-records ruling; not legal advice
rows.public_boundary: Disposition records show what happened to evidence after review; they do not decide admissibility or public-records duties.
rows.required_records: retention rule; disposition action; digest; owner; date; derivative status; hold/exception

rows.custody_floor: Keep live promotion no-go until every applicable custody row has local records, owners, reviewer approval, or a documented local exception.
rows.custody_risk: A release is promoted from synthetic to live use because packets verify, while custody, access, transfer, sealing, and disposition records are missing.
rows.next_action: Keep live promotion no-go until every applicable custody row has local records or documented exceptions.
rows.non_claims: not chain-of-custody certification; not live authorization; not legal advice
rows.public_boundary: The custody gate keeps evidence handling explicit; it is not chain-of-custody certification and not legal advice.
rows.required_records: local custody matrix; gap burndown; exceptions; reviewer approvals; no-go closure note
rows.reviewer_role: release maintainer custody lead and election office sponsor
